description: New live path for Moonshine Streaming: a dedicated worker hosting the single-thread moonshine-wasm module, fed the recording's 16 kHz frames continuously (not VAD utterances), transcript update interval ~0.3-0.5 s. Map onText -> provisional tokens (replaceProvisional) and onLine -> final tokens with segment-interpolated timing on our sample clock; decide whether its internal VAD replaces Silero for utterance boundaries or we keep our VadSegmenter for speaker windows and only use Moonshine for text (keep one sample clock, see irl-subt-9ij.16). Integrate with LocalEngines load/progress/ModelWarmup, degraded states, WebGPU-free error recovery, and the scheduler (A5). Live harness test with real models. Keep tjs-asr Whisper live path for language=auto.
title: Live STT adapter on moonshine-wasm streaming
